description: Welcome to this rare opportunity. Situated in a quiet, highly desirable Silicon Valley neighborhood, this 1980-built home offers both a prime location and strong income potential, ideal for homeowners and investors alike. The home features a 5-bedroom layout. The kitchen offers granite countertops, appliances, and ample cabinetry. The family room connects to the kitchen and features a cozy fireplace, with a sliding door leading to the backyard for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Set on a generous lot, it offers flexibility for outdoor living, expansion, or future value-add opportunities. Both
